others.route: Aufenthaltserlaubnis zur Beschäftigung (Kultur und Unterhaltung, § 25 BeschV)

note: Germany: EEA and Swiss nationals live and work freely (the eea list). Everyone else needs a residence title for employment, which the Federal Employment Agency may approve for artistic work after a labour-market test (§ 25 BeschV). A performer keeping their home abroad who is employed at a festival or sent with a guest performance or a foreign film or television production needs no approval for up to 90 days within twelve months (§ 22 no. 2), and that work doesn't count as employment needing a residence title (§ 30 no. 2): taken as 90 days within 365 worked without the permit (the conditions aren't modelled; appearances in day performances, up to 15 days a year, likewise).
